info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Billing Management API
info.description: The Corporate Billing Management API facilitates efficient billing processes for enterprise clients by enabling the creation and submission of corporate billing requests. This API streamlines financial transactions and assists businesses in managing their billing inquiries. Common use cases include generating invoices, tracking payment statuses, and reconciling billing discrepancies. Ideal for finance teams and billing departments, this API enhances operational efficiency and ensures timely financial management.

post.summary: Create a new corporate billing record.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new corporate billing record for your enterprise services. Upon successful creation, a billing record will be established, enabling the management and tracking of corporate billing transactions.
